title: Can you check for your blower control
summary: During the session, the assistant connected to the user's browser via CDP on port 9222 and navigated to WhatsApp Web to help manage messages. Addy successfully sent a text to the user's mother saying he would be late for dinner and also managed to send a reminder note about a pending English project to the user's self-chat after working through a few technical input errors. The conversation touched upon an unresolved security warning the user encountered while trying to sign into the browser using their email through the automated session. The user insisted on sticking with the current browser despite the restriction, and expressed annoyance at repetitive prompts to brainstorm about AI or cursors, which the assistant acknowledged and agreed to drop. Moving forward, they need to address how to handle the browser sign-in security warning or decide on the next tasks to tackle within the current setup.
